raw_response:
I farm alone, so I will keep this year practical and labor-efficient. Cotton is my main crop, and on 10.1 mu with well irrigation, I will still put most of my land into cotton because I know it best and it gives me the most stable return in my conditions. I will keep a smaller area in chili for cash income, but not too much because chili needs more hands-on management and more spraying. I will also plant some mungbean on a small area because it is easier to manage, fits my experience, and helps spread risk. Since it is the start of the growing season, I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps stand establishment and yield, apply moderate fertilizer rather than pushing too hard, rely on a few timely irrigations from my well, and use rotary tillage because it is efficient for me at my age and scale. I will manage chili more intensively, cotton at a steady medium-input level, and mungbean more lightly.
